text_block_list.text: During training with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ugh! My legs are all gross!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was raining not that long ago, so the
track's
condition is just the worst!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe we should. I really wanna
keep
going, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we call it a day around here?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As a cute Umadol, I think this amount of
mud is
just not gonna work...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't let myself get cold... Maybe I
should
stretch for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, Trainer! It looks like Oguri is
training
too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow Umadol, I can't not say
hello! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course! After all...
choice_data_list: Is Oguri Cap an Umadol too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oguri is super popular with people in her

hometown, Kasamatsu!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In my eyes, that makes her a super
famous
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there, Oguri! ☆ We're
both totally
covered in mud, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Falco? Now that you mention it,
we are.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of finishing up soon. Are you
gonna
keep going?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't training in the mud bother you
at all?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think it's because no matter how dirty I
get,
everyone in my hometown has
always supported
me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm going to get back to training.
See you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh! Looks like my research was
lacking!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That unflappable spirit must be the core
of
Oguri's Umadol identity!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! I can't let anyone outdo me
when it
comes to sheer Umadol spirit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta train with Oguri and get closer
to
becoming a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta train with Oguri and get closer
to
becoming a top Umadol!
choice_data_list: Let's ask them for a tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! ☆ I'm off, then!
choice_data_list: Let's ask them for a tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Oguri! I'm gonna keep training too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Falco... I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Let's run until we feel like we're
going to
collapse.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! I was hoping you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you. I have more to look
forward to
now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After all, the more energy you expend,
the more
delicious the food you eat
afterwards will taste.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Is that the reason why you don't care if you get dirty while you train?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: YAAAAGH!
Craaash!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Falco?! It's too early to collapse!

Afterwards, Smart Falcon continues
running with
Oguri Cap, significantly
improving her hardiness
and
perseverance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the plan! Well then, off I
go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oguri! I was wondering if you'd
mind doing
some partner running with
me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Falco... Okay, sure.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You set the pace, and I'll run from
behind, like a
real race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! I was hoping you'd say that!
After they finish their training...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Falco, you've got mud on your
cheek.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No! No, no, no! I can deal with it if it's on my tracksuit, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an Umadol, my face is a no-go!
Trainer, get me
a towel!

...In any case, Smart Falcon's awareness
as a front
runner improves significantly
thanks to pair
running with Oguri Cap!
